description:
Benchmark and platform pages are central browse flows, but the audit could
not fully evaluate them because they currently render cost-schema binder
errors. Once route correctness is restored, these pages need a focused
retheme and usability pass. Current code shows legacy native selects, mixed
segmented controls, static-looking filter clusters, white tables/cards, a
bottom compare selection bar, and page-specific table/chart treatments that
are not aligned with the intended BenchBox product identity.

This item covers `/results/:benchmark/` and `/results/p/:platform/`.
It should make benchmark matrices, rank/list modes, platform timelines,
filters, row selection, compare entry, empty states, and responsive behavior
feel like one coherent data-browse system.

anti_patterns.dont: chart mixed benchmark/scale cohorts as a single comparable trend.
hide compare selection state behind table scroll.
make mobile users inspect large matrices without a scroll cue or card fallback.
retheme benchmark and platform pages independently with divergent controls.

preserves.behavior: Existing row-selection to Compare flow with compact IDs when available.
Sortable table behavior added by pass-2 follow-ups.

verifications.description: Benchmark and platform unit tests pass

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep "benchmark|platform"
verifications.description: Browser smoke covers benchmark and platform pages

verifications.command: echo 'Manual: capture benchmark and platform routes at 390, 768, 1280, 1600 and verify controls, tables, charts, compare bar, empty states, and no raw errors'

work_units.notes:
Outcome: captured 16 screenshots (4 routes × 4 widths) at
`_project/audits/screenshots/results-retheme-browse-pages-after-fix-2026-05-07/`
via the new `e2e/captures/browse-pages-retheme.spec.ts` Playwright spec
(gated on `RETHEME_CAPTURE=1` so it does not run on every CI invocation).
Routes covered: `/results/tpch/?sf=0.01&phase=standard`,
`/results/star_schema/?sf=0.1&phase=power`, `/results/p/duckdb/`,
`/results/p/polars/`.
work_units.summary: Re-audit rendered benchmark and platform pages after the schema blocker is fixed

work_units.notes:
Outcome: filter cluster (scale/phase/tuning selects + trust chips) and
high-contrast toggle migrated to surface tokens; matrix/ranks/list view
toggle migrated to the shared `<SegmentedControl>` primitive (with
`role="radiogroup"`/`role="radio"`). Breadcrumb and page-title surfaces
were already token-driven from TODO #1; no changes there.
work_units.summary: Normalize page headers, breadcrumbs, and primary controls

work_units.notes:
Outcome: token migration applied to BenchmarkIndex and to the matrix
surface (QueryHeatmap), the ranks view (RankTable), and the list view.
Sortable column behavior preserved verbatim (heatmap `toggleSort`,
list-view `ListSortHeader`). Selected-row state on QueryHeatmap unified
to use `--bb-tone-info-bg` + `--bb-accent-hover` border across mobile
cards and desktop rows.
work_units.summary: Retheme BenchmarkIndex matrix, rank, and list views

work_units.notes:
Outcome: token migration applied to PlatformIndex; trend section
(TimeSeries, SparklineTable) and cohort grouping markup retained
verbatim. Cohort labelling/comparability semantics were already in place
from earlier work; no structural change required for the retheme.
work_units.summary: Retheme PlatformIndex table, trend sections, and cohort grouping

work_units.notes:
DESCOPED FROM THIS PR — DEFERRED to a follow-up. to `results-explorer-retheme-responsive-accessibility` (TODO #6).
Pre-existing mobile behavior is preserved verbatim by this PR:
QueryHeatmap renders compact cards at narrow widths (see lines 250-290),
PlatformIndex tables retain `overflow-x-auto` horizontal scroll with the
Compare selection bar sticky to the bottom. The "design per surface"
decision (cards vs sticky-column scroll) is a cross-route call that
belongs to the responsive-accessibility pass, not to a single browse
PR.
work_units.summary: Design mobile browse behavior for dense matrices and platform tables

work_units.notes:
DESCOPED FROM THIS PR — DEFERRED to a follow-up.. Pre-existing compare-selection model preserved across both
pages: same `selectedIds` state shape, same compare URL builder
(`buildCompareUrl`), same incompatibility feedback. Selected-row
visuals were unified on QueryHeatmap during w3. Deeper "selected-count
language + button state + comparability messaging" unification is a
UX-copy decision that belongs in a follow-up rather than a token-driven
retheme PR.
work_units.summary: Unify compare-selection behavior and the selected-result bar

work_units.notes:
DESCOPED FROM THIS PR — DEFERRED to a follow-up.. Empty / error / not-found surfaces inherit the new tone-*
tokens from the TODO-1 migration of `ErrorMessage` and the existing
inline copy. Branded empty-state primitives `<EmptyState>` and
`<ErrorState>` exist (added by TODO #1) but the call-site rewrite
that replaces inline copy with those primitives is left for the
responsive-accessibility / release-gate sweep where the empty states
can be exercised across all four browse routes consistently.
work_units.summary: Polish empty, filtered-empty, and not-found states
